title.zh: 修订第2268号共和国法（授予Aras-Asan Timber Company, Inc.在菲律宾境内建设、维护与运营私人点对点及船岸无线电台临时许可）的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Two Hundred Sixty-Eight, Entitled "An Act Granting the Aras-Asan Timber Company, Inc. a Temporary Permit to Construct, Establish, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Private Ship-to-Shore Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines"
title.orig: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Two Hundred Sixty-Eight, Entitled "An Act Granting the Aras-Asan Timber Company, Inc. a Temporary Permit to Construct, Establish, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Private Ship-to-Shore Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4423_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred sixty-eight is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. There is hereby granted to the Aras-asan Timber Company, Inc., its successors or assigns, a temporary permit to construct, maintain and operate in the Philippines, at such places as the grantee may select, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications private fixed point-to-point, private ship-to-shore, private aeronautical and land-based and land mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of wireless messages on radiotelegraphy and radiotelephony, each station to be provided with a radio transmitting apparatus and a radio receiving apparatus."

Section four of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 4. The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall not engage in domestic business telecommunications in the Philippines without further special assent of the Congress of the Philippines, it being understood that the purpose of this temporary permit is to secure to the grantee the right to construct, establish, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point, private ship-to-shore, private aeronautical and land-based and land mobile radio stations in such places within the Philippines as the interest of its trade and business may justify."

The title of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"An Act granting the Aras-asan Timber Company, Inc., a temporary permit to construct, establish, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point, private ship-to-shore, private aeronautical and land-based and land mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of radio telecommunications within the Philippines."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
